subject: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@atlas-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC success criteria & trial plan - Atlas Payments

Hi Tara — great call today, thanks for the time. Summary below and proposed next steps for the POC/trial. Please reply with any additions or changes and confirm owners/timebox.

Recap of goals we heard from Atlas: 
- Deploy an LLM-based inference pipeline for customer support triage and routing (mixed short-form messages).
- Improve routing accuracy and reduce manual triage load.
- Maintain sub-250ms p95 latency for single-message inference at peak traffic.

Draft success criteria (we can iterate):
1) Latency: p95 end-to-end inference latency < 250 ms (measured from request receive to response ready) under target throughput profile.
2) Throughput: sustain 200 requests/sec with service-level degradation <5%.
3) Cost: inference cost <= $0.0005 per token (target average over trial).
4) Quality: intent classification top-1 accuracy >= 92% on your holdout set; average human-annotator disagreement <= 10%.
5) Stability: no more than 2 production-impacting errors during the trial window.

Evaluation plan / instrumentation: 
- Dataset: Atlas will provide a 10k message labeled holdout (anonymized) + a 1k live-sampled stream for latency testing.
- Test harness: Redwood will run synthetic and replay tests; we'll also run live A/B on a small percentage (5%) of traffic if you approve.
- Metrics: we'll capture token counts, per-request latency (p50/p90/p95), throughput, error rates, and quality metrics (accuracy, precision/recall by intent). Dashboards: we will share a link to a live dashboard and daily summary emails.

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope & SLA notes (owners: Jordan + Atlas PM)
- Week 1: data transfer, infra setup, baseline run with small dataset (owner: Marcus)
- Week 2: full 10k evaluation + live replay latency tests (owners: Marcus / Marissa)
- Week 3: analysis, tuning, and readiness decision / wrap-up meeting (owners: Jordan / Tara)

Owners / asks: 
- Atlas: provide anonymized 10k labeled dataset + redaction notes by EOD Fri (Tara).
- Redwood infra/eng: Marcus to provision trial infra and sample dashboard; Marissa to own quality evaluation and run comparison tests.
- Legal/Security: Tara to confirm SOC2 evidence / basic data handling needs (we can prepare a security pack).

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (draft plan), sla-draft.docx (SLA template).

Next steps: please confirm the timeline & owners and whether you approve a 5% live traffic sample for latency/throughput validation. Propose a quick sync Thurs 10am PT to sign off.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Also CCing Carlos Mendes (our PM for integrations) so he can help with data export formats — Carlos, Jordan/Marissa/Marcus are Redwood leads.

Thanks Tara — adding answers and a couple adjustments from the infra/QA side.

Security / data handling:
- We will only request anonymized or redacted message text for the labeled set; for live replay latency tests we can accept redacted tokens or hashed identifiers.
- I'll drop the SOC2 pack into the Drive folder (link below) and add a short doc describing what logs we capture and how long we retain them during the trial (default: 30 days, adjustable).

POC harness and metrics: 
- For stability we recommend running two parallel configs: a quantized 8-bit model variant for cost/throughput, and a full-precision variant for quality comparisons.
- We'll surface a per-request cost estimate and a running cost-per-token metric in the dashboard so you can watch spend during the run.
- Suggested acceptance thresholds: cost <= $0.0005/token and delta in quality between quantized/full <= 3 percentage points.

Timeline adjustment: shifting the evaluation window out by one week works for us — new plan looks good. We'll update the plan PDF and SLA draft and push to Drive.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodAtlasPOC
